title: Lesson 4: CPU Pipelining & Data Hazards — js-tools
desc: The 5-stage IF-ID-EX-MEM-WB pipeline overlapping instructions to raise throughput, the timing formula T=(N+S-1+stall)×tclk, and RAW/WAR/WAW data hazards with forwarding and stalls. Verified by running a hand-written engine: 1 million instructions with no stalls take exactly 500,002ns at 2GHz, and 600,002ns with 200,000 stalls (CPI rising from 1 to 1.2). A real RAW chain gives 0 stalls with forwarding and exactly 4 without; a load-use hazard (LW then immediate use) still needs exactly 1 stall even with forwarding on. Demo: a time/CPI calculator plus a hazard simulator with a forwarding toggle.
